'''''Perfect Dark''''' is a cancelled [[First-person shooter|first-person shooter game]] that was under development by The Initiative and [[Crystal Dynamics]] for [[Windows]] and [[Xbox Series X and Series S|Xbox Series X/S]]. As a [[Reboot (fiction)|reboot]] of the ''[[Perfect Dark (series)|Perfect Dark]]'' series, the game aimed to revitalize the franchise with modern gameplay mechanics and a new narrative. Set in a near-future world grappling with environmental collapse, players would have stepped into the role of agent [[Joanna Dark]], navigating a world where megacorporations conceal secrets amidst efforts to restore ecological balance.

Announced at [[The Game Awards 2020|The Game Awards]] in 2020, ''Perfect Dark'' was the first project by The Initiative, a first-party team established by [[Xbox Game Studios]] in 2018. Production was slowed by various problems, including significant personnel turnover and creative differences. A gameplay trailer was revealed at the [[Xbox Games Showcase]] in June 2024. In July 2025, it was announced that the game would cease production and that The Initiative would be closed as part of [[2022–2026 video game industry layoffs|numerous rounds of layoffs]] by Microsoft.

== Gameplay ==
[[File:Perfect Dark reboot gameplay.jpg|left|thumb|220x220px|The player engaging in combat]]
''Perfect Dark'' was intended to be a [[first-person shooter]] drawing inspiration from [[immersive sim]]s and [[stealth game]]s.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Linneman |first1=John |title=What have we learned from Perfect Dark's gameplay reveal trailer? |url=https://www.eurogamer.net/digitalfoundry-2024-perfect-dark-what-can-we-glean-about-its-tech-from-the-reveal-trailer |website=Eurogamer.net |language=en |date=June 19, 2024}}</ref> Players would have had the option to engage in direct combat with enemies or employ stealth tactics, utilizing advanced gadgets for distraction and infiltration. The game features a parkour system, enabling the protagonist, Joanna, to navigate the environment by clambering down pipes and running along walls.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Makuch |first=Eddie |date=January 11, 2024 |title=Perfect Dark - Everything We Know |url=https://www.gamespot.com/articles/perfect-dark-everything-we-know/1100-6505937/ |access-date=June 17, 2024 |website=[[GameSpot]] |language=en-US}}</ref><ref name="faq">{{Cite web |last=Tolbert |first=Samuel |date=June 15, 2024 |title=Perfect Dark FAQ: Xbox Game Pass, story, gameplay, and everything you need to know |url=https://www.windowscentral.com/gaming/xbox/perfect-dark-faq-xbox-game-pass-story-gameplay-and-everything-you-need-to-know |access-date=June 17, 2024 |website=[[Windows Central]] |language=en}}</ref> Players can eliminate or incapacitate enemies using firearms and melee combat, with Joanna smoothly sliding and running through combat scenarios. The game allows for environmental interaction, such as shooting a fire extinguisher to create a temporary cover cloud.<ref>{{Cite web |last1=Valentine |first1=Rebekah |last2=Stedman |first2=Alex |date=June 9, 2024 |title=Xbox Finally Shows Off its Perfect Dark Reboot - Xbox Games Showcase 2024 |url=https://www.ign.com/articles/xbox-finally-shows-off-its-perfect-dark-reboot-xbox-games-showcase-2024 |access-date=June 17, 2024 |website=IGN |language=en}}</ref>

Stealth was supposed to be a significant component of the gameplay. Players would've been presented with options for how to deal with oncoming encounters and objectives, such as choosing to sneak past adversaries or using high-tech gadgets to deceive them. Joanna's HUD would have provided capabilities such as seeing enemies through walls and scanning them for details. Additionally, her voice analysis tool was intended to be capable of mimicking an enemy's voice to open voice-activated locks or distract foes with false communications.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Campbell |first=Evan |date=June 12, 2024 |title=Iconic Perfect Dark Dev Says He 'Would've Loved' To Work On The Reboot |url=https://www.gamespot.com/articles/iconic-perfect-dark-dev-says-he-wouldve-loved-to-work-on-the-reboot/1100-6524205/ |access-date=June 17, 2024 |website=[[GameSpot]] |language=en-US}}</ref> ''Perfect Dark'' would've followed a more linear, mission-based structure as opposed to open-world gameplay. The game's parkour mechanics were meant to enable Joanna to perform actions such as wall running, scaling buildings, and sliding along scaffolding, which would have enabled her to access otherwise unreachable locations.<ref name="faq" /><ref>{{Cite web |last=Lennox |first=Jesse |date=June 12, 2024 |title=Perfect Dark: release date window, trailers, gameplay, and more |url=https://www.digitaltrends.com/gaming/perfect-dark-release-window-trailers/ |access-date=June 17, 2024 |website=[[Digital Trends]] |language=en}}</ref>

==Premise==
''Perfect Dark'' is set in a near-future world experiencing environmental collapse, with megacorporations attempting to address the crisis while concealing their own secrets. Players assume the role of agent [[Joanna Dark]], a skilled operative seeking to uncover the truth behind these events. According to an article on Xbox Wire, the game's setting involves significant ecological disasters, collectively referred to as "The Cascade," causing widespread devastation on Earth. Core Mantis, a megacorporation, creates The GEN Network and deploys it in [[Cairo]], [[Egypt]], successfully restoring the region's ecosystem and making it habitable once again. Following this success, other major companies also get involved, but hidden agendas are at play. This reimagined futuristic version of Cairo serves as the main setting for the game.<ref name="faq" />

The protagonist, Joanna Dark, is a special operative working for the megacorporation dataDyne. The character is portrayed through performance capture by actress [[Alix Wilton Regan]], with her facial likeness based on model Elissa Bibaud.<ref name="Game Awards 2020" /> Joanna is proficient in firearms, advanced gadgets, stealth, and close-quarters combat. Her mission involves investigating and capturing Daniel Carrington, the world's most wanted criminal, who is hiding in the restored city of Cairo with a radioactive device. Despite her expertise, Joanna is not infallible, and part of the game's narrative focuses on her growth and learning from her mistakes, reflecting the aspirational nature of the game's title.<ref name="Gameplay gameplay trailer" /><ref name="faq" />

==Development==
[[File:The Initiative Logo.png|thumb|The logo for The Initiative]]
''Perfect Dark'' was intended to be the debut project by The Initiative, an internally formed first-party team within [[Xbox Game Studios]] founded in 2018 and headed by Darrell Gallagher.<ref name="Initiative founded"/> At its formation, it aimed to create and produce big-budget titles. In addition to Gallagher, the studio recruited several industry veterans, including [[Christian Cantamessa]] (writer of ''[[Red Dead Redemption]]'') and Brian Westergaard (senior producer of 2018's ''[[God of War (2018 video game)|God of War]]''), as well as talents from [[BioWare]], [[Naughty Dog]], [[Respawn Entertainment]], [[Santa Monica Studio]], [[Blizzard Entertainment]], [[Insomniac Games]] and [[Rockstar Games]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.videogameschronicle.com/news/xboxs-new-studio-signs-yet-more-experience-from-respawn-bioware/|title=Xbox's new studio signs yet more experience from Respawn, BioWare|first=Andy|last=Robinson|work=Video Games Chronicles|date=August 12, 2020|access-date=December 11, 2020}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://gamingbolt.com/the-initiative-recruits-former-naughty-dog-rockstar-programmer|title=The Initiative Recruits Former Naughty Dog, Rockstar Programmer|first=Shubhankar|last=Parijat|work=GamingBolt|date=May 12, 2020|access-date=December 11, 2020}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.videogameschronicle.com/news/xbox-studio-hires-group-of-god-of-war-designers/|title=Xbox studio hires group of God of War designers|first=Andy|last=Robinson|work=Video Games Chronicles|date=July 23, 2019|access-date=December 11, 2020}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.videogameschronicle.com/news/analysis-whos-working-on-the-new-perfect-dark/|title=Analysis: Who's working on the new Perfect Dark?|first=Andy|last=Robinson|work=Video Games Chronicles|date=December 12, 2020|access-date=December 13, 2020}}</ref> Gallagher, who had previously worked on the 2013 ''[[Tomb Raider (2013 video game)|Tomb Raider]]'' reboot, chose to work on a ''[[Perfect Dark (series)|Perfect Dark]]'' reboot after Microsoft presented him with a few opportunities.<ref name="Modern opportunities"/> Plans for the game had already been discussed before Gallagher joined The Initiative,<ref name="Xbox family"/> with [[Xbox]] head [[Phil Spencer (business executive)|Phil Spencer]] stating that the game is seen as an opportunity for protagonist [[Joanna Dark]] to diversify the Xbox family.<ref name="Modern opportunities"/> According to a source, the game will run on [[Unreal Engine 4]] and feature "various weapons, gadgets, and a camera surveillance system".<ref name="First hints"/> Design director Drew Murray revealed that the game is being envisioned as a spy shooter, and that the studio wants the player character's physicality to play a bigger role than in traditional [[first-person shooter]]s.<ref name="Spy shooter"/> In February 2021, Murray left The Initiative to rejoin [[Insomniac Games]].<ref name="Murray leaves"/> Shortly afterwards, ''[[God of War (2018 video game)|God of War]]'' producer Rhonda Cox joined the company as senior producer for the game.<ref name="Cox joins"/>

In September 2021, The Initiative announced they would be partnering with [[Crystal Dynamics]] on the game's development.<ref name="Hired Crystal Dynamics"/> Daniel Neuburger, who had previously directed several ''[[Tomb Raider]]'' games at Crystal Dynamics, was the game director,<ref name="Daniel Neuburger"/> until he left The Initiative in February 2022.<ref name="Neuburger left Initiative"/> In the previous 12 months, a substantial number of developers had also left the company, citing a lack of creative autonomy and slow development progress as the reason for their departures.<ref name="Fast and furious"/> In May 2022, after [[Embracer Group]] announced that they had entered an agreement with [[Square Enix]] to acquire Crystal Dynamics, The Initiative confirmed that they would still continue to co-develop the game with the studio.<ref name="Embracer Deal"/> In November 2022, Xbox Studios boss Matt Booty revealed that, after the departure of several senior staff members at The Initiative, the ''Perfect Dark'' team has been slowly rebuilding while dealing with the challenges of the [[COVID-19 pandemic]] and starting up a new studio.<ref name="Booty Update"/>

By June 2023, ''Perfect Dark'' was still in pre-production and roughly two to three years away from release. It was also revealed that [[Certain Affinity]] was involved in its development before The Initiative announced that they would co-develop the game with Crystal Dynamics. Due to multiple factors, including poor management and creative differences between both studios, progress on the game stalled. In 2022, after The Initiative partnered with Crystal Dynamics, development restarted under [[Unreal Engine 5]] and was a bit more productive. There are plans for the game to follow an episodic format, but it could still change before release.<ref name="Still years away"/> It was also reported that [[The Coalition (company)|The Coalition]] has been supporting both studios with their Unreal Engine expertise.<ref name="WC gameplay trailer"/> [[Grant Kirkhope]], who composed most of the original ''[[Perfect Dark]]'' score, expressed his desire to work on the game, but a new composer was chosen instead.<ref name="Grant Kirkhope"/> In October 2024, it was reported that former Insomniac Games developer Brian Horton had left the studio, where he was acting as creative director on ''[[Marvel's Wolverine]]'', to join The Initiative as ''Perfect Dark''{{'}}s new creative director over the summer.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Totilo |first=Stephen |title=Scoop: PlayStation's Wolverine creative director is now leading Xbox's Perfect Dark |url=https://www.gamefile.news/p/wolverine-perfect-dark-brian-horton-playstation-xbox |access-date=October 31, 2024 |website=www.gamefile.news |language=en}}</ref> 

===Cancellation===
In July 2025, it was announced that The Initiative would be closed, and that development of the project would be stopped as part of [[2022–2026 video game industry layoffs|several rounds of layoffs]] by Microsoft.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.windowscentral.com/gaming/xbox/microsoft-is-closing-down-xbox-studio-the-initiative|title=Microsoft is closing down Xbox studio The Initiative, with Perfect Dark killed as well — joining Everwild and ZeniMax's IP, and other unannounced projects|last=Corden|first=Jez|work=Windows Central|date=July 2, 2025|access-date=July 2, 2025}}</ref> Joanna Dark actress [[Alix Wilton Regan]] called for fans to "speak up if [they] wanna see ''Perfect Dark'' survive", while actor [[Elias Toufexis]], who voiced [[Adam Jensen]] in the ''[[Deus Ex]]'' series, said the cancellation resulted in a loss of "thousands of dollars" that he was expecting for his role in the game.<ref name="Actors reaction"/> EA Japan's general manager Shaun Noguchi expressed concerns about the numerous layoffs and the cancellation of ''Perfect Dark'' and [[Rare (company)|Rare]]'s ''[[Everwild (video game)|Everwild]]'', which had been in development for roughly seven and eight years respectively, stating: "That's a decade of work, potentially a quarter of someone's entire career completely lost. Even if the final product isn't what people originally expected, I think it still deserves to ship. Something is better than nothing for both the team and for the players. But also, don't announce games when they're still half baked."<ref name="EA Japan"/> [[Xbox (console)|Xbox]] co-creator [[Seamus Blackley]] echoed similar sentiments, "Think of the number of great games that had troubled development histories. All of them? Now consider how often executives cancel troubled games. Smooth development comes only when you take no risks. Greatness comes only when great risks are braved."<ref name="EA Japan"/>

In September 2025, it was reported that Microsoft briefly held talks with [[Take-Two Interactive]] regarding the latter taking over development funding and publishing duties in an effort to revive the game, but said talks fell through due to disputes over ownership of the game and property, which in part led to additional layoffs at Crystal Dynamics.<ref name="Take Two"/> Wilton Regan later revealed that she had recorded entire chapters of the game's universe before its cancellation, and that Crystal Dynamics suffered considerable job losses.<ref name="Entire chapters"/> In July 2026, it was reported that [[Id Software]], a developer under Xbox's [[ZeniMax Media]] subsidiary, had pitched a separate ''Perfect Dark'' game to Microsoft, but was rejected due to new CEO [[Asha Sharma]]'s wish to orient all of its first-party developers towards prioritizing proven tentpole franchises.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Robinson |first=Andy |date=2026-07-09 |title=Doom studio Id Software pitched a Perfect Dark game before Xbox cuts |url=https://www.videogameschronicle.com/news/doom-studio-id-software-pitched-a-perfect-dark-game-before-xbox-cuts/ |access-date=2026-07-11 |website=VGC |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Onder |first=Cade |date=2026-07-09 |title=id Software Was Reportedly 'Toying With' Pitches for a New Perfect Dark, a John Wick-Inspired Game, and More Before Layoffs |url=https://www.ign.com/articles/id-software-was-reportedly-toying-with-pitches-for-a-new-perfect-dark-a-john-wick-inspired-game-and-more-before-layoffs |access-date=2026-07-11 |website=IGN |language=en}}</ref>

==Marketing==
Although work on a ''Perfect Dark'' revival was rumored in early 2018,<ref name="Revival rumor"/> ''Perfect Dark'' was officially announced at [[The Game Awards 2020]] with a cinematic trailer,<ref name="Game Awards 2020"/> after development on the game had been hinted by some sources earlier that year.<ref name="First hints"/> A gameplay trailer was revealed at the [[Xbox Games Showcase]] on June 9, 2024.<ref name="WC gameplay trailer"/> After the game was cancelled, former level designer Adam McDonald confirmed that most of the game mechanics showcased in the demo were not scripted, though the gameplay systems were still in a rudimentary stage.<ref name="Real gameplay"/>
